what.en: Bullying is when someone hurts, scares, or shames another child again and again. It can be hitting, name-calling, or mean messages online, called cyberbullying.
what.fil: Ang pambu-bully ay kapag paulit-ulit na sinasaktan, tinatakot, o pinapahiya ng isang bata ang iba. Maaari itong pananakit, panlalait, o masasamang mensahe online, na tinatawag na cyberbullying.

signs.en: A friend seems sad, stays alone, or doesn't want to go to school. Broken things, mean posts about them, or being left out can be signs too.
signs.fil: Mukhang malungkot ang kaibigan, laging nag-iisa, o ayaw pumasok sa paaralan. Maaari ring senyales ang nasirang gamit, masasamang post tungkol sa kanya, o pag-iwan sa kanya.

before.en: Be kind and include others. Know your trusted adults at school, like your teacher, the guidance counselor, or the principal.
before.fil: Maging mabait at isama ang iba. Kilalanin ang mapagkakatiwalaang nakatatanda sa paaralan, tulad ng iyong guro, guidance counselor, o punong-guro.

during.en: Speak up and tell a trusted adult! Calmly say “Stop,” walk away, and stay near friends. Never hit back or join in.
during.fil: Magsalita at magsabi sa mapagkakatiwalaang nakatatanda! Mahinahong sabihin ang “Tigil,” lumayo, at manatili malapit sa mga kaibigan. Huwag gumanti o makisali.

after.en: Tell a teacher or your parents, even if it already stopped. Schools must keep you safe and keep reports private. It is never your fault.
after.fil: Sabihan ang guro o magulang, kahit tumigil na ito. Dapat kang panatilihing ligtas ng paaralan at gawing pribado ang ulat. Hindi mo ito kasalanan kailanman.

signoff.en: Remember: be kind, speak up, and tell a trusted adult!
signoff.fil: Tandaan: maging mabait, magsalita, at magsabi sa nakatatanda!
